discoverySources.title: First Zombies vs Plants v0.1 match and player feedback
discoverySources.note: Plants: Overgrowth + Spore Swarm; Zombies: Restless Dead + The Turned. A single game's feedback is a research prompt, not proof of global imbalance. Several Zombie answers stayed in the library, Eviscerate was milled, and Regrowth remained unused; draw variance and sequencing matter alongside interaction density.
Both feedback and accepted actions were considered; the Plant deck's removal actually succeeded, so these are comparison candidates rather than blanket additions to the winning faction.
Existing candidate facts for Insidious Fungus, Sundering Growth, Martyred Rusalka, and Feed the Swarm; retained Oracle data from prior Scryfall MCP research.

resolvedLeads.name: Timber Golem
resolvedLeads.note: The exact-name lookup returned no card. Do not treat this proposed name as a verified Magic card or silently replace it with a different card.

resolvedLeads.name: Nessian Wanderer
resolvedLeads.result: type correction; not included in botanical candidates
resolvedLeads.note: Nessian Wanderer is a Satyr Scout, not a Dryad or Plant. Its enchantment-based land selection does not by itself establish the botanical creature theme.

resolvedLeads.resolution: The linked white candidate is Juniper Order Advocate (2W 1/2 Human Knight; untapped anthem for green creatures). Juniper Order Druid is a different green card (2G 1/1 Human Cleric Druid; tap to untap a land). The Druid name was verified separately through Scryfall MCP and is not treated as a white candidate.

resolvedLeads.note: Counts refer to bounded tree and forest art searches, not the number of curated candidates.
